hero.title: Where the farm meets the ridgeline
hero.status: Coffee tours daily · Kitchen by arrangement

specifics.title: Three private homes on twenty acres of working land — organic produce, coffee plantation, farm-to-table kitchen, fifteen minutes from Sámara Beach.

farm.title: A working farm, not a backdrop
farm.body: Sustainability is central to our ethos. We cultivate fruits, vegetables, and coffee using eco-friendly methods on-site. Guests enjoy fresh organic produce during their stay — and can take it home through Blue Mountain Farms.

coffee.title: From slope to cup
coffee.body: Walk the plantation, learn the delicate process of Costa Rican coffee-making, and cup the roast grown on these slopes.

people.title: Hospitality with proper nouns
people.body: Josué and the team keep every villa pristine and every trail open — world-class care on a working mountain farm.

footer.tagline: Luxury eco-tourism in the Blue Zone

accommodation.whatToPackValue: Light layers, reef-safe sunscreen, walking shoes, appetite for coffee
